details: Coinbase announced a deal on a crucial provision in a landmark U.S. crypto legislation, potentially paving its way through the Senate. The compromise addresses a dispute with banks over stablecoin issuers offering yield-bearing rewards, aiming to allow Americans to earn rewards while establishing new stablecoin regulations. This move seeks to end regulatory uncertainty for crypto firms.
title: Coinbase Reports Breakthrough on US Crypto Stablecoin Bill

details: Paradigm researcher Dan Robinson introduced the Provable Address-Control Timestamps (PACTs) model to shield dormant Bitcoin from future quantum computing attacks. This method allows Bitcoin holders to prove ownership via on-chain timestamps without moving coins, offering a proactive defense against quantum key derivation.
title: Paradigm Proposes PACTs to Protect Bitcoin from Quantum Threats

details: Central bank decisions this week, including the Federal Reserve's stance on maintaining high interest rates through December 2026, have failed to boost crypto market confidence. The "higher-for-longer" monetary policy reduces risk appetite, pushing the crypto Fear and Greed Index towards "fear" and hindering sustained demand.
title: Central Banks' Tight Policy Weakens Crypto Market Confidence

details: U.S. spot Ethereum ETFs recorded over $101 million in net inflows on May 1st, led by BlackRock's ETHA. BlackRock also significantly cut the staking fee for its iShares Staked Ethereum Trust (ETHB) from 18% to 10% of gross staking rewards. This aims to enhance ETHB's appeal to investors, making Ethereum a more attractive yield-bearing asset for institutions.
title: Ethereum ETFs See Inflows; BlackRock Cuts Staking Fee for ETHB

details: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded approximately $2.44 billion in net inflows during April 2026, nearly doubling March's figures. This surge in institutional capital absorbed market supply, with BlackRock's IBIT capturing over 70% of the month's total. This strong demand has provided a robust floor for Bitcoin's valuation, despite broader macroeconomic concerns.
title: Bitcoin ETFs Attract Nearly $2B in April, Boost Market
